# Version 4.152.0
> **M152 engine and GPU APIs** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU bindings with asynchronous pixel readback. The release expands GPU integration, improves native package support, and fixes resource-lifetime issues while reducing common managed allocation overhead.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through Chrome M152 servicing** — The bundled renderer advances from late M151 stability fixes to the Chrome M152 engine and its subsequent servicing updates. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can integrate Skia's newer GPU rendering backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs for non-blocking pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel and region objects retain their native sources** — Fixes native use-after-free failures involving SKRegion span iteration and SKPixmap subsets or transformed pixmaps. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native resource cleanup corrected** — Fixes raster-image allocation cleanup, HarfBuzz blob conversion cleanup, and replacement uniform-buffer disposal. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed allocation overhead reduced** — Reduces unnecessary copies, boxing, reflection, and lookup-map growth in text, data, runtime-effect, and tag operations. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **HarfBuzz shaping avoids defensive feature-array copies** — Font shaping no longer creates an unnecessary defensive Feature array copy. ([#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — Restores production availability of SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET and validates its Vulkan integration across Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Nano Server font support** — Nano Server native packages use FreeType to provide font support on that platform. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple native symbols included in package builds** — Apple native symbol packages are produced during packing to improve native-symbol availability for Apple deployments. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz Font.Shape allocation behavior and native resource cleanup, while refreshing package documentation and native package symbol handling.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 added the M152 servicing update, restored production packaging for Vulkan Silk.NET, and improved runtime resource cleanup and allocation behavior.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0-preview.1.1...v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced the Chrome M152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package. It also delivered native resource-lifetime fixes and Nano Server font support.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.3...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
